payload.name: Multiples.vc
payload.description: 上市公司可比估值、并购与风投数据
payload.summaryOriginal: Public comps, M&A and VC data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access public comps, verified M&A multiples and VC data straight from ChatGPT.

Built for investment banking, PE and VC ecosystem, Multiples MCP delivers investment-grade valuation intelligence inside your favorite AI tool.

Try queries like "cybersecurity strategic M&A buyers" "median SaaS public NTM multiples," or "biggest VC rounds in Europe this year" and get structured, sourced answers back instantly.
payload.longDescription:
直接通过 ChatGPT 获取上市公司可比估值、经核验的并购估值倍数和风险投资数据。

Multiples MCP 面向投资银行、私募股权（PE）和风险投资（VC）生态系统，在你常用的 AI 工具中提供投资级估值情报。

试着查询“网络安全领域的战略并购买家”“上市 SaaS 公司未来十二个月（NTM）估值倍数中位数”或“今年欧洲最大的风险融资轮次”，即可即时获得结构化、有来源的答案。

payload.name: Hyperline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to Hyperline to manage quotes, invoices, subscriptions, customers, products, pricing, taxes, wallets, and revenue data. Use it to answer billing questions, inspect customer context, monitor revenue, and perform safe billing workflows from your Hyperline account.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Hyperline，管理报价、发票、订阅、客户、产品、定价、税费、钱包和收入数据。用它回答账单问题、查看客户背景、监控收入，并从 Hyperline 账户执行安全的账单工作流程。

payload.name: WalleK
payload.description: 追踪资金、账单和对账单
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WalleK is a personal finance ledger. Through ChatGPT it can add an expense or income, look up what was spent over a period, break spending down by vendor or category, show account and card balances, list recurring bills and mark them paid, follow loan installments and salary records, and read an uploaded bank or card statement and turn it into ledger entries for the user to approve. It works in multiple currencies. Every write goes to the signed-in user's own ledger only.
payload.longDescription: WalleK是一款个人财务账本工具，通过ChatGPT可添加支出或收入、查询特定时段的消费记录、按供应商或分类分解支出、展示账户及卡片余额、列出定期账单并标记已支付、跟踪贷款分期和薪资记录，并能读取上传的银行或信用卡对账单，将其转换为待用户审批的账本条目。该工具支持多种货币，所有记录仅保存到已登录用户的个人账本中。

payload.name: Amok
payload.description: 柬埔寨银行与科技法规
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Amok gives ChatGPT direct access to Cambodia's banking, fintech, and technology regulation — as verbatim evidence from official sources, never paraphrased.

Ask about bank licensing and prudential rules, technology risk management, liquidity risk, payment systems and Bakong, AML/CFT, or fintech policy. Amok searches a corpus built from Cambodia's official sources — the National Bank of Cambodia's laws, prakas, and guidelines, and the Securities and Exchange Regulator of Cambodia — and returns the exact provisions: precise Article citations, current validity, and an official source link on every result so you can verify the original wording yourself. When something is missing from the corpus, Amok says so instead of guessing.

The corpus is in English. Ask in any language — ChatGPT translates and answers grounded in the official text. Results support research and compliance work; they are not a substitute for legal counsel. Free, no account needed.
payload.longDescription:
Amok 让 ChatGPT 直接访问柬埔寨的银行、金融科技和技术监管规定，提供来自官方来源的逐字证据，绝不改写。

可询问银行许可和审慎监管规则、技术风险管理、流动性风险、支付系统及 Bakong、AML/CFT 或金融科技政策。Amok 搜索由柬埔寨官方来源构建的语料库，包括柬埔寨国家银行的法律、prakas 和指引，以及柬埔寨证券交易监管机构的资料，并返回准确条款：每项结果均包含精确条文引用、当前效力和官方来源链接，方便你自行核对原文。如果语料库缺少相关内容，Amok 会明确说明，而不会猜测。

语料库为英文。你可以用任何语言提问，ChatGPT 会翻译并依据官方文本回答。结果支持研究与合规工作，不能代替法律顾问。免费，无需账户。

payload.name: PGicover
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PGicover helps Canadian business owners understand personal guarantee insurance, get an indicative monthly cost estimate for insuring a personal guarantee on commercial debt, and check basic eligibility. Underwritten by Markel, rated A plus by AM Best. Applications are completed at app.pgicover.com.
payload.longDescription: PGicover 帮助加拿大企业主了解个人担保保险，获取为商业债务个人担保投保的参考月度费用估算，并检查基本资格。由 Markel 承保，AM Best 评级为 A plus。申请在 app.pgicover.com 完成。

payload.name: Neptune Flood
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Flooding is one of the most common and costly natural risks in the United States, yet getting a flood insurance quote has often been confusing and time consuming.

This app connects ChatGPT directly to Neptune Flood’s quoting system, allowing you to quickly retrieve real time flood insurance quote information for a specific property. Receive flood insurance pricing information within the ChatGPT conversation in seconds.

The goal is simple: make accessing flood insurance quotes faster, clearer, and easier.
This app provides quote information only. It does not offer advice, recommend coverage amounts, or make coverage decisions.

Important Information

ChatGPT is not an insurance agent, broker, or representative of Neptune Flood. The information presented is based on the details provided at the time of the quote request. This quote does not constitute a binder of coverage, an offer to insure, or a guarantee of coverage. Coverage is subject to underwriting review, eligibility requirements, policy terms, conditions, exclusions, and applicable state regulations.

If you have questions about coverage, limits, deductibles, or whether this policy is appropriate for your needs, please consult a Neptune agent or other insurance professional.

Quotes are valid for sixty (60) days from the date generated, unless otherwise indicated. Pricing, eligibility, and terms are subject to change.

Neptune Flood is not responsible for any reliance placed on information interpreted, summarized, or communicated by third party AI systems.
payload.longDescription:
洪灾是美国最常见、损失最昂贵的自然风险之一，但获取洪水保险报价往往令人困惑且耗时。

此应用将 ChatGPT 直接连接至 Neptune Flood 的报价系统，让你快速获取特定房产的实时洪水保险报价信息。在 ChatGPT 对话中，几秒即可收到洪水保险价格信息。

目标很简单：让洪水保险报价的获取更快、更清晰、更方便。
此应用仅提供报价信息，不提供建议、不推荐保障额度，也不作承保决定。

重要信息

ChatGPT 不是 Neptune Flood 的保险代理人、经纪人或代表。所展示的信息基于申请报价时提供的资料。此报价不构成临时承保凭证、承保要约或保障承诺。保障须符合核保审核、资格要求、保单条款、条件、除外责任，以及适用的州法规。

如对保障范围、限额、免赔额，或该保单是否适合你的需求有疑问，请咨询 Neptune 代理人或其他保险专业人士。

除非另有说明，报价自生成之日起六十（60）天内有效。价格、资格与条款可能变化。

对于因依赖第三方 AI 系统解读、总结或传达的信息而产生的后果，Neptune Flood 不承担责任。

payload.name: Savvly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Savvly MCP helps financial advisors, planning tools, and AI agents compare retirement alternatives, check eligibility, and model lump-sum, monthly-contribution, and full-retirement scenarios. These tools support the Savvly Longevity Benefit, an SEC-registered fund designed to combine market exposure with later-life longevity payouts.
payload.longDescription: Savvly MCP 帮助财务顾问、规划工具和 AI 智能体比较退休方案、检查资格，并模拟一次性投入、每月缴款和完整退休情景。这些工具支持 Savvly Longevity Benefit，这是一只在 SEC 注册的基金，旨在将市场敞口与晚年长寿给付相结合。

payload.name: Pine Labs Payment Assistant
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pine Labs Payment Assistant is a secure, read-only connector that helps authorized merchants access and understand their payment data using natural language. It provides clear insights into orders, payments, payment links, settlements, transactions, plans, and subscriptions without creating, modifying, or executing payments.
payload.longDescription: Pine Labs Payment Assistant 是安全的只读连接器，帮助获授权商户通过自然语言访问并理解付款数据。它提供有关订单、付款、付款链接、结算、交易、套餐和订阅的清晰见解，不创建、修改或执行付款。

payload.name: Assurance Emprunteur Lemoine
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Estimez en quelques secondes le tarif de votre assurance de prêt immobilier et l'économie possible grâce à la loi Lemoine. Répondez à quelques questions et l'app calcule des offres réelles à garanties équivalentes ; un conseiller peut ensuite vous rappeler gratuitement. Service proposé par JeRenegocie, courtier en assurance inscrit à l'ORIAS. Estimations indicatives, sans engagement.
payload.longDescription: 几秒内估算房贷保险价格，以及通过 Lemoine 法可能节省的金额。回答几个问题，应用便会计算保障相同的实际方案；之后顾问可免费致电联系你。服务由已在 ORIAS 登记的保险经纪商 JeRenegocie 提供。估算仅供参考，不具有约束力。

payload.name: Trucordia Go
payload.description: 住宅与汽车保险保费估算
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The ChatGPT Trucordia Go tool helps users explore estimated auto and home insurance premiums in the United States (U.S.) through ChatGPT. End users answer a series of questions and receive a preliminary estimate of U.S. auto and home insurance premiums. When they're ready to get personalized quotes, they receive a URL containing encoded parameters for the Trucordia Go AI assistant, which resumes the process from where they left off.
What Users Can Do:

Get rough monthly premium estimates for U.S. auto and home insurance.
Switch between auto and home quotes in the same conversation — their information carries over.
Continue with Trucordia's own AI assistant for personalized quotes, or get connected with a licensed advisor at Trucordia.
See bundling options for U.S. home and auto insurance.
Collects only limited estimate factors such as ZIP code, driver count, primary driver age, young-driver status, vehicle count, home year built, and square footage. 

What This App Does Not Do:

Does not collect name, street address, date of birth, SSN, email address, payment details, bank details, or health information inside ChatGPT.
Does not collect personal health information.
Does not generate binding quotes or exact pricing.
Does not bind coverage or issue policies.
Does not collect payment card, credit card, or any financial information.
Does not take payments.
payload.longDescription:
ChatGPT Trucordia Go 工具帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 了解美国（U.S.）汽车和住宅保险的预估保费。最终用户回答一系列问题后，可获取美国汽车和住宅保险保费的初步估算。准备获取个性化报价时，用户会收到包含编码参数的 URL，供 Trucordia Go AI 助手从上次停止的位置继续流程。
用户可以做什么：

获取美国汽车和住宅保险每月保费的粗略估算。
在同一段对话中切换汽车和住宅报价，已提供的信息会沿用。
通过 Trucordia 自有 AI 助手继续获取个性化报价，或联系 Trucordia 的持牌顾问。
查看美国住宅和汽车保险的捆绑选项。
仅收集有限的估算因素，例如邮政编码、驾驶员人数、主要驾驶员年龄、是否有年轻驾驶员、车辆数量、住宅建造年份和平方英尺面积。

本应用不会做什么：

不会在 ChatGPT 内收集姓名、街道地址、出生日期、SSN、电子邮件地址、支付详情、银行详情或健康信息。
不收集个人健康信息。
不生成具有约束力的报价或精确价格。
不承保或签发保单。
不收集支付卡、信用卡或任何财务信息。
不收取付款。

payload.name: HelpDol
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Control your business by chatting with ChatGPT.

HelpDol is an AI-powered financial management app for sales professionals, service providers, self-employed workers, freelancers, contractors, and small business owners. Connect your bank account once in the HelpDol app and your income and expenses are imported automatically — no manual typing, no duplicates.

Then just ask. Check your profit, balance, cash flow, accounts payable and receivable, and how much you have paid each helper. Sort out the transfers that still need review, schedule upcoming payments with reminders, generate receipts for helpers and clients, pull your yearly report for the accountant, and charge customers by card or payment link — all from the chat.
payload.longDescription:
通过与 ChatGPT 对话管理你的业务。

HelpDol 是由 AI 驱动的财务管理应用，面向销售人员、服务提供商、自雇人士、自由职业者、承包商及小企业主。在 HelpDol 应用中连接一次银行账户，收入和支出便会自动导入，无需手动输入，也不会重复导入。

之后只需提问。查看利润、余额、现金流、应付及应收账款，以及向每位帮工支付了多少费用。处理仍需审核的转账、安排未来付款并设置提醒、为帮工和客户生成收据、调出给会计师的年度报告，并通过银行卡或支付链接向客户收款——全部在对话中完成。

payload.name: ALPS Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This plugin helps attorneys estimate a non‑binding range of lawyers' professional liability (LPL) insurance premiums based on basic inputs like state, practice area, and attorney count. It provides quick guidance to support early planning and coverage conversations, without collecting personal information or requiring an application.
payload.longDescription: 本插件帮助律师根据州、执业领域和律师人数等基本输入，估算不具约束力的律师职业责任（LPL）保险保费范围。它提供快速指引，支持前期规划和保障讨论，不收集个人信息，也不要求提交申请。

payload.name: Investra
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Investra connects your real estate investment workflow to your AI assistant. Search and evaluate property listings, run investment analyses, review projected returns and cash flow, and share investor-ready reports — all from chat. The integration uses the same data, permissions, and plan limits as the Investra web app, so anything done through the assistant matches what you'd see in your account. Built for real estate professionals who want to spend less time on manual analysis and more time advising on deals and closing them.
payload.longDescription: Investra 将房地产投资工作流程连接到 AI 助手。直接在对话中搜索和评估房源、运行投资分析、查看预期回报与现金流，并分享可供投资者使用的报告。该集成使用与 Investra 网页应用相同的数据、权限和套餐限制，因此通过助手进行的任何操作都与你在账户中看到的结果一致。专为房地产专业人士打造，让他们减少手动分析的时间，将更多时间用于交易咨询和促成成交。

payload.name: KeyBid Puls
payload.description: 评估购房用于短租的可行性
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Unlock the profitability of short-term rental investments with our ROI Calculator app, tailored for platforms like Airbnb, Booking.com, and VRBO. Users can paste property URLs from sites such as idealista.com, imobiliare.ro, storia.ro, and spitogatos.gr (with more integrations on the way), or upload screenshots from other real estate platforms. The app analyzes the data to deliver instant revenue projections, detailed reports, and a concise conclusion on whether the property is worth purchasing for short-term rentals. Covering 56 countries and over 191 cities, it supports multiple languages including English, Romanian, Spanish, and Greek for seamless global use. Ideal for property owners and investors seeking data-driven insights to evaluate vacation rental opportunities. Explore more at https://keybid.eu/keybid-puls.
payload.longDescription: 使用我们的投资回报率计算器应用，发掘短租投资的盈利能力，专为 Airbnb、Booking.com 和 VRBO 等平台量身打造。用户可粘贴 idealista.com、imobiliare.ro、storia.ro 和 spitogatos.gr 等网站的房产 URL（更多集成正在推出），或上传其他房地产平台的截图。应用分析数据，立即给出收入预测、详细报告，以及该房产是否值得购入用于短租的简明结论。覆盖 56 个国家和超过 191 个城市，支持英语、罗马尼亚语、西班牙语和希腊语等多种语言，方便全球使用。适合希望通过数据洞察评估度假租赁机会的房主和投资者。更多信息：https://keybid.eu/keybid-puls.

payload.name: In Practise
payload.description: 面向投资者的一手研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
In Practise runs primary research for fundamental investors. We interview the former operators and executives who ran the companies you're analysing, then turn those conversations into structured, cited research.

This connector brings that library into ChatGPT. You can:

- Search thousands of expert interviews across public and private companies, sectors and business models
- Read full interviews and analysis, with verbatim quotes you can attribute to each source
- Look up companies and the moats behind them, assessed with the 7 Powers framework: scale economies, network effects, counter-positioning, switching costs, branding, cornered resource and process power
- Track the companies you care about with a personal watchlist

Ask ChatGPT about a company, a competitor or an end market, and it pulls the relevant primary-source view from people who were actually in the room, rather than a summary scraped from the web.

Access requires an In Practise library subscription. Learn more at inpractise.com.
payload.longDescription:
In Practise 为基本面投资者开展一手研究。我们访谈曾经运营和管理你所分析公司的前运营人员及高管，再将这些对话转化为结构化、带引用的研究。

此连接器将该资料库带入 ChatGPT。你可以：

- 搜索覆盖上市及非上市公司、行业和商业模式的数千篇专家访谈
- 阅读完整访谈和分析，使用可归属到各个来源的逐字引述
- 查询公司及其护城河，按照 7 Powers 框架评估：规模经济、网络效应、反向定位、转换成本、品牌、独占资源和流程优势
- 使用个人观察名单跟踪关注的公司

向 ChatGPT 询问某家公司、竞争对手或终端市场，它会提取真正亲身参与者的相关一手观点，而非从网上抓取的摘要。

访问需要订阅 In Practise 资料库。了解更多：inpractise.com。

payload.name: Juspay Genius
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask payment questions in plain English: query order and transaction analytics, look up specific orders, check recent outages, and inspect gateway settings — all from your Juspay Dashboard, inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 用日常英语询问付款问题：查询订单和交易分析、查找特定订单、查看近期服务中断，以及检查支付网关设置——全部通过 Juspay Dashboard，在 ChatGPT 中完成。

payload.name: Dr. Klein
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Dr. Klein Mortgage Calculator calculates mortgage interest rates, monthly mortgage payments, the remaining loan balance, and the total interest costs of a mortgage. The property purchase price, down payment, repayment rate, and other financing details can be adjusted individually. Based on the entered data, the calculator provides various financing offers that can be compared side by side at a glance.
The Dr. Klein Mortgage Calculator is suitable for planning a mortgage for the purchase of a property, a new-build project, or a refinancing.
The calculations are based on the latest terms and conditions of more than 600 lending partners. As the final financing terms depend on individual circumstances, the calculated results are provided for guidance only. After completing the calculation, a personalized financing offer can be requested directly from Dr. Klein.
payload.longDescription:
Dr. Klein 按揭计算器计算按揭利率、每月还款额、剩余贷款余额和按揭总利息成本。房产购买价格、首付款、还款比例及其他融资详情均可单独调整。根据输入数据，计算器提供多种融资报价，可并排比较，一目了然。
Dr. Klein 按揭计算器适用于规划购房、新建项目或再融资的按揭贷款。
计算依据来自 600 多家贷款合作伙伴的最新条款和条件。由于最终融资条件取决于个人情况，计算结果仅供参考。完成计算后，可直接向 Dr. Klein 申请个性化融资报价。

payload.name: Solo 401k Calculator
payload.description: 计算 Solo 401k 缴款限额
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find out your maximum Solo 401(k) contribution in seconds. Enter your income, age, and business type to see employee and employer contribution limits, plus after-tax room for Mega Backdoor Roth. Supports sole proprietorships, LLCs, and S-corps. Updated for 2025 and 2026 limits.

* For educational purposes only. Not financial or tax advice. Consult a professional before making financial decisions.
payload.longDescription:
几秒内了解你的 Solo 401(k) 最高缴款额。输入收入、年龄和企业类型，即可查看员工及雇主缴款限额，以及 Mega Backdoor Roth 可用的税后缴款空间。支持个体经营、LLC 和 S-corp。已更新为 2025 和 2026 年限额。

* 仅供教育用途。不构成财务或税务建议。作出财务决定前，请咨询专业人士。

payload.name: Per Diem
payload.description: 掌握您的财务与财务自由
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Per Diem lets you analyze your full financial life with AI. Connect your Per Diem account to ask questions about your net worth, account balances, holdings, transactions, budgets, current-year cash flow, and FIRE plan.

Use it to answer questions like:

“Can we afford a trip to Mexico next winter?”
“When am I projected to reach financial independence?”
"How much can I spend per day to stay on budget this month?"
“Summarize my net worth and biggest holdings.”
“Find recent transactions from Amazon or restaurants.”
“How concentrated is my portfolio?”

Per Diem provides read-only financial context from your connected accounts and planning data so ChatGPT can help you understand spending patterns, review budgets, inspect transactions, evaluate portfolio concentration, and reason about your path to financial independence. Per Diem does not move money, make trades, change your data, or provide legal, tax, accounting, or investment advice.
payload.longDescription:
Per Diem通过AI帮助您分析完整的财务生活。连接您的Per Diem账户，即可询问关于净资产、账户余额、持仓、交易、预算、当年现金流和FIRE计划的问题。

可用于回答以下问题：

“我们能负担得起明年冬天去墨西哥旅行吗？”
“我预计何时能达到财务自由？”
“本月保持预算的前提下，每天能花多少钱？”
“总结我的净资产和主要持仓。”
“查找来自亚马逊或餐厅的最近交易。”
“我的投资组合集中度如何？”

payload.name: PointBagel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PointBagel keeps track of your U.S. credit cards and points, and does the math on them. payload.name: Assurance Temporaire

payload.name: TaxMadeEazy: Rideshare Ded
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Who it's for: U.S. rideshare and gig economy drivers — Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Instacart, and similar platforms. Whether you're a full-time driver or earning on the side, TaxMadeEazy helps you discover deductions you might be missing.

payload.longDescription:
需要向国外汇款？Monito 帮助你在几秒内比较国际汇款服务，让你始终获得最优汇率、最低费用和最快到账速度。

payload.name: Whisper Money
payload.description: 通过对话了解个人财务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Whisper Money is a privacy-first personal finance app: your financial data is yours, and it is never shared with third parties. This app connects ChatGPT to your own Whisper Money account so you can analyse your money in plain language instead of clicking through dashboards.

Ask questions like "how much did I spend on groceries last month", "what's my net worth trend this year", "which subscriptions are draining me" or "break down Q2 by category" — the app reads your transactions, accounts, categories, labels, cashflow and net worth and answers with your real numbers. You can also keep your books tidy from the conversation: log manual transactions, recategorize and label existing ones, record balances for manual accounts, and manage categories, labels and automation rules.

Your synced bank data is protected: transactions imported from a bank connection can be categorized and labelled, but never edited or deleted, and balances can only be recorded on manual accounts. You can still add your own manual transactions to a bank-connected account — a sync never removes them. Data is scoped to the account you sign in with, including any shared spaces you belong to. The app reads and writes bookkeeping records only — it can never move money, make payments or reach any account outside Whisper Money.

Requires a Whisper Money account on a paid (Pro) plan. Sign in happens through Whisper Money's own OAuth flow — ChatGPT never sees your password, and access can be revoked at any time from your account settings.
payload.longDescription:
Whisper Money 是一款隐私优先的个人理财应用：你的财务数据属于你，绝不会与第三方共享。此应用将 ChatGPT 连接到你自己的 Whisper Money 账户，让你通过日常语言分析资金情况，无需逐一点击仪表盘。

你可以问“我上个月买食品杂货花了多少钱”“我今年的净资产趋势如何”“哪些订阅在消耗我的钱”或“按类别拆分Q2”——应用读取你的交易、账户、类别、标签、现金流和净资产，并用你的真实数字回答。你还可以在对话中整理账目：记录手动交易、为现有交易重新分类和添加标签、记录手动账户余额，以及管理类别、标签和自动化规则。

同步的银行数据受到保护：从银行连接导入的交易可以分类和添加标签，但不能编辑或删除；余额只能记录到手动账户。你仍然可以向已连接银行的账户添加自己的手动交易——同步永远不会删除它们。数据范围限于你登录的账户，包括你所属的共享空间。应用仅能读写记账记录——绝不能转移资金、付款或访问 Whisper Money 之外的任何账户。

需要订阅付费（Pro）方案的 Whisper Money 账户。登录通过 Whisper Money 自身的OAuth流程进行——ChatGPT 无法看到你的密码，你可随时在账户设置中撤销访问权限。

payload.name: Kova
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kova gives ChatGPT a persistent home for a user's investment strategy. Users save their investment rules once, then ask ChatGPT to review a portfolio against the same plan whenever they need a check-in. Kova returns repeatable briefs with an alignment score, portfolio drift, strategy-rule checks when configured, and changes that would restore alignment. It keeps the user's plan anchored across sessions, so each review starts from the saved investment standard instead of a blank chat. Kova does not place trades, manage assets, provide financial advice, or predict markets.
payload.longDescription: Kova 为 ChatGPT 提供一个可持续保存用户投资策略的空间。用户只需保存一次投资规则，就能在需要检查时让 ChatGPT 根据同一计划审视投资组合。Kova 返回可重复生成的简报，包含一致性评分、投资组合偏离情况、已配置的策略规则检查，以及恢复一致性所需的调整。它跨会话保存用户计划，让每次审视都从已保存的投资标准开始，而不是从空白聊天开始。Kova 不下单交易、不管理资产、不提供财务建议，也不预测市场。

payload.name: ClarityTrack

Everything is strictly read-only: ChatGPT can see what you can see, and can never move money or change settings. Data access is granted per-user via OAuth and can be revoked at any time from ClarityTrack settings.
payload.longDescription: ClarityTrack是您AI助手的财务数据层。连接您的ClarityTrack账户后，ChatGPT即可读取您的实时财务状况：账户余额、近期交易、按类别计算的服务器支出、预算位置、带有进度的目标，以及Clarity标记的洞察信息（价格涨幅、重复收费、收入异常）。所有数据均为只读模式：ChatGPT能看到您能看到的内容，且无法操作资金或修改设置。数据访问通过OAuth按用户授权，可随时从ClarityTrack设置中撤销。

payload.name: Steadworth

payload.name: Advance America

payload.name: OptionsAhoy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Exercise now or wait. Sell at vest or hold. Which lots to sell first. Each of these has a right answer for your specific situation, and it turns on how alternative minimum tax (AMT), holding periods, state tax, and the time value of taxes paid early interact across several years. That is where rules of thumb break down. Ask in plain language and OptionsAhoy returns the answer with the year-by-year schedule behind it.

1. Which incentive stock options (ISOs) to exercise in which year, to hold down AMT and recover the credit later. We optimize across multiple years, with your tax status in mind.

2. Whether to sell restricted stock units (RSUs) at vest or hold for long-term capital gains, and what the twelve-month cliff is actually worth. We show you the optimal solution.

3. Which vested RSU lots to sell and in what order, and what that saves against selling oldest-first (the default order your broker's UI will offer). This sounds like a minute optimization. On a $725,000 sale from a concentrated position, the gap between the optimal order and your broker's default could be over $100,000 in tax.

4. Whether non-qualified stock options (NSOs) are better exercised and sold, or exercised and held.

5. Whether your shares pass the six statutory tests for qualified small business stock (QSBS). Best to check early for potential tax savings, the rules just changed.

6. How exposed a single position leaves you, and what selling down, holding, or hedging each cost. We calculate and compare different strategies across three years, with your taxes in mind.

7. What a protective put or a zero-cost collar prices at. If you need to protect your holdings, you're probably considering a hedge. But which one? We make it easy to decide.

8. How to convert some of your holdings to a target amount of after-tax cash by a deadline with the smallest tax bill. We optimize against your inputs and risk tolerance, then you choose, the way an investment firm would.

Every result is computed against the federal tax code plus all fifty states and the District of Columbia. The 2026 federal constants match IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32. Federal cases reproduce to the cent against the independently maintained PSL Tax-Calculator, and state results reproduce to the cent against OpenTaxSolver across California, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Massachusetts. That proof recomputes live in your browser at optionsahoy.com/verification.

This matters because language models are confident and wrong at exactly this task. In a published benchmark, five frontier models were given the same multi-year ISO problem, three runs each. All five overstated the after-tax value of their own proposed schedules, by 1.6x to 17.6x against the provable optimum. One model claimed $3.9M, $5.2M, and $13.0M on three runs of identical input. The prompt and full transcripts are public at optionsahoy.com/benchmark. The arithmetic here is deterministic instead: the same inputs on the same date give the same answer every time, with no model inference anywhere in the number.

Free, no account, no API key, and your figures are not retained. United States tax logic only. This is a planning calculator, not tax advice.
payload.longDescription:
现在行权还是继续等待？归属时出售还是继续持有？先出售哪些批次？针对你的具体情况，这些问题都有相应的最优答案，而答案取决于替代性最低税（AMT）、持有期限、州税以及提前缴税的时间价值如何在多年间相互影响。经验法则在这里往往失效。用日常语言提问，OptionsAhoy 会给出答案及其背后的逐年安排。

1. 在哪一年行使哪些激励性股票期权（ISOs），以压低 AMT，并在以后收回税收抵免。我们会结合你的税务状况，跨年度优化。

2. 限制性股票单位（RSUs）应在归属时出售，还是持有以适用长期资本利得税，以及十二个月的门槛究竟有多大价值。我们会展示最优方案。

3. 应出售哪些已归属的 RSU 批次、按什么顺序出售，以及相比先卖最早批次（券商界面提供的默认顺序）能省多少税。这听起来只是微小的优化。但对于一笔来自集中持仓的 $725,000 出售，最优顺序与券商默认顺序之间的税额差距可能超过 $100,000。

4. 非合格股票期权（NSOs）是行权后出售更好，还是行权后持有更好。

5. 你的股票是否通过合格小企业股票（QSBS）的六项法定测试。为争取潜在税收优惠，最好尽早检查，相关规则刚刚发生变化。

6. 单一持仓使你面临多大风险，以及减持、继续持有或对冲分别需要付出什么成本。我们会考虑你的税务情况，计算并比较三年内的不同策略。

7. 保护性看跌期权或零成本领口策略的价格是多少。如果需要保护持仓，你可能正在考虑对冲。但应该选哪一种？我们让这个决定更容易。

8. 如何在截止日期前，以最低税额把部分持仓转换为目标金额的税后现金。我们根据你的输入和风险承受能力优化方案，再由你选择，方式与投资公司类似。

每项结果都依据联邦税法以及全部五十个州和哥伦比亚特区的税法计算。2026 年联邦参数与 IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32 一致。联邦案例与独立维护的 PSL Tax-Calculator 核对，结果精确到美分一致；加利福尼亚州、纽约州、新泽西州、宾夕法尼亚州和马萨诸塞州的州税结果与 OpenTaxSolver 核对，也精确到美分一致。你可以在 optionsahoy.com/verification 的浏览器页面中实时重新计算并验证。

这很重要，因为语言模型在这类任务上恰恰会自信地给出错误答案。在一项公开基准测试中，五个前沿模型接收了相同的多年 ISO 问题，每个运行三次。全部五个模型都高估了自身方案的税后价值；与可证明的最优解相比，所报告的倍率为 1.6x 至 17.6x。一个模型对完全相同的输入，在三次运行中分别声称得到 $3.9M、$5.2M 和 $13.0M。提示词和完整记录公开于 optionsahoy.com/benchmark。这里的计算则是确定性的：同一日期的相同输入每次都会得到相同答案，数值计算中完全不使用模型推理。

免费，无需账户或 API 密钥，也不保留你提供的金额数据。仅适用美国税务逻辑。这是规划计算器，不构成税务建议。

payload.longDescription: NP Ledger 为普通非营利组织提供基金会计服务，面向亲自记账的创始人、簿记员和主管。此连接器让 AI 助手用日常语言读取和更新账簿：检查基金余额和资助支出，记录捐款、费用和账单，运行报告；每笔记录的底层都正确区分限定用途与非限定用途基金的会计处理。访问权限遵循你的角色；一键连接，随时断开。

payload.name: Square Deal
payload.description: 检查房产是否被高估计税价值
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Square Deal helps homeowners check if their home is overassessed. Enter a property address to review appraisal data, comparable properties, potential reduction, and estimated tax savings.
payload.longDescription: Square Deal 帮助房主检查自住房产的计税评估价值是否偏高。输入房产地址，查看评估数据、可比房产、潜在减估幅度及预计节税金额。

payload.name: Drivetrain
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use natural language to analyze your Drivetrain data in ChatGPT. Fetch metrics, dimensions, and versions, explore trends, and generate insights seamlessly.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中用自然语言分析 Drivetrain 数据。获取指标、维度和版本，探索趋势，并顺畅地生成见解。

payload.name: PortfolioFit
payload.description: 以代理为核心的组合分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PortfolioFit compares normalized portfolio holdings with written mandates, identifies evidence gaps, and calculates explicit allocation constraints without placing trades or changing holdings.
payload.longDescription: PortfolioFit将标准化的组合持仓与书面指令进行比较，识别证据缺失，并计算明确的分配限制，而无需进行交易或调整持仓。

payload.name: Finom
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Finom is a business finance platform for SMEs and freelancers across Europe, combining a business account, invoicing, expense management, and accounting in one place.

This connector gives ChatGPT access to your Finom business data. Ask about transactions and spending across your accounts, look up invoices and payment status, review card activity, and check bookkeeping records and tax deadlines.

You need an active Finom account to use this connector. Access is limited to the companies your account is authorized for, and you approve access through Finom’s standard sign-in.
payload.longDescription:
Finom 是面向欧洲中小企业和自由职业者的企业财务平台，将企业账户、开票、费用管理和会计整合于一处。

此连接器让 ChatGPT 访问你的 Finom 企业数据。可以询问各账户的交易及支出，查询发票和付款状态，查看银行卡交易活动，并检查记账记录和税务截止日期。

使用此连接器需要有效的 Finom 账户。访问仅限于该账户获授权的公司，你通过 Finom 的标准登录流程批准访问。

payload.name: StackerScan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Track coin and bar pricing with StackerScan. Get live precious metal spot prices and typical asking premiums from recent gold and silver marketplace listings.  

Includes price history and Goldback exchange rates. No account or API key required.
payload.longDescription:
通过StackerScan追踪硬币和金条定价。
获取实时贵金属现货价格及近期黄金和白银市场报价中的典型溢价。

包含价格历史和Goldback兑换汇率。
无需账户或API密钥。

payload.name: Vings
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vings lets authenticated users inspect their own financial data through ChatGPT, including transactions, cashflow, spending categories, merchants, recurring payments, budgets, connected bank status, portfolio snapshots, portfolio history, and preferences.
payload.longDescription: Vings 让已认证用户通过 ChatGPT 查看自己的财务数据，包括交易、现金流、支出类别、商家、定期付款、预算、已连接银行的状态、投资组合快照、投资组合历史和偏好。

payload.name: FinOpps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get instant answers about upcoming work, revenue, customer payments, and business performance from your FinOpps account.
payload.longDescription: 从您的FinOpps账户中获取关于待办事项、收入、客户付款及业务表现的即时答案。

payload.name: OnePro AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
O OnePro conecta sua conta ETF1 ao ChatGPT e dá acesso à mesma base de dados e
aos mesmos motores de análise que você usa na plataforma.

Consulta de ativos: fichas completas de ETFs brasileiros e globais, ações, BDRs,
FIIs, fundos CVM, debêntures, renda fixa pública e privada e índices,  custos,
patrimônio líquido, retornos históricos, alocação e composição. Screener com
filtros por classe, look-through da carteira de ETFs (inclusive ETFs de ETFs) e
lookup reverso ("quais ETFs carregam NVDA?").

Análise de carteira: seus portfólios salvos no OnePro, ou uma carteira informada
na conversa, avaliados por retorno, volatilidade, Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown
máximo, tempo de recuperação e correlação, contra benchmarks como CDI, IBOV,
IFIX, IMA-B e S&P 500. Inclui ranking entre carteiras, consistência em janelas
móveis de 10 anos e heatmap de CAGR real por ano inicial.

Motores de simulação: fronteira eficiente e carteira de máximo Sharpe;
probabilidade de atingir uma meta de patrimônio (goal-based investing); projeção
prospectiva de patrimônio por Monte Carlo; e plano de retirada da aposentadoria
com taxa segura (SWR), taxa perpétua (PWR) e estratégias clássico,
rebalanceado, bucket e dynamic spending com guardrails.

Todos os resultados vêm de um snapshot diário de dados, com a versão do dado
declarada em cada resposta, e os motores raciocinam em termos reais (R$ de hoje e dólar).
O conector é somente leitura: nenhuma operação altera dados da sua conta, e
nenhuma ordem de compra ou venda é executada. As análises são informativas e não
constituem recomendação de investimento.

Requer assinatura ativa do OnePro em etf1.com.br.
payload.longDescription:
OnePro 将您的 ETF1 账户连接到 ChatGPT，让您访问与平台中使用的相同数据库和分析引擎。

资产查询：提供巴西和全球 ETF、股票、巴西存托凭证（BDR）、房地产投资基金（FII）、CVM 基金、公司债券、公私部门固定收益产品及指数的完整资料，包括费用、净资产、历史收益、资产配置和组成。支持按资产类别筛选、穿透分析 ETF 投资组合（包括投资 ETF 的 ETF），以及反向查询（“哪些 ETF 持有 NVDA？”）。

投资组合分析：根据收益、波动率、夏普比率、索提诺比率、最大回撤、恢复时间和相关性，评估您保存在 OnePro 中的组合，或在对话中提供的组合，并与 CDI、IBOV、IFIX、IMA-B 和 S&P 500 等基准比较。包括组合排名、10 年滚动窗口的一致性，以及按起始年份展示实际复合年增长率（CAGR）的热力图。

模拟引擎：有效前沿和最大夏普比率组合；达到资产目标的概率（目标导向投资）；通过蒙特卡洛模拟预测未来资产；以及退休提款计划，包含安全提款率（SWR）、永久提款率（PWR），以及传统、再平衡、分桶和带有护栏机制的动态支出策略。

所有结果均来自每日数据快照，每次回答均注明数据版本；引擎以实际购买力计算（按今日价值计的 R$ 和美元）。连接器仅提供只读访问：任何操作都不会更改账户数据，也不会执行买入或卖出订单。分析仅供参考，不构成投资建议。

需要在 etf1.com.br 上拥有有效的 OnePro 订阅。

payload.name: FinPilot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: O FinPilot ajuda o usuário a consultar contas, cartões, lançamentos e saldos da sua planilha financeira pessoal pelo ChatGPT. Também permite validar, criar, atualizar, replicar, marcar, excluir e desfazer lançamentos mediante as permissões concedidas no OAuth. O app registra somente as informações fornecidas pelo usuário, não acessa bancos, não usa Open Finance e não movimenta dinheiro.
payload.longDescription: FinPilot 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查询个人财务电子表格中的账户、卡片、账目记录和余额。它还允许按照 OAuth 中授予的权限，对账目记录进行验证、创建、更新、复制、标记、删除和撤销。应用仅记录用户提供的信息，不访问银行，不使用 Open Finance，也不转移资金。

payload.name: Sumline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sumline helps real estate professionals get reliable property numbers inside ChatGPT without having to teach the AI how to calculate each scenario. Ask naturally about seller net proceeds, buyer cash to close and monthly housing costs, rental property returns, or fixed-rate mortgage payments. Sumline runs the same deterministic calculation engines used by the Sumline web app and returns the verified figures, assumptions, warnings, and a link to continue the scenario in Sumline. Sumline does not determine loan qualification or affordability and does not provide legal, tax, lending, appraisal, or investment advice.
payload.longDescription: Sumline 帮助房地产专业人士在 ChatGPT 中获取可靠的房产数字，无需教 AI 如何计算每种情景。用自然语言询问卖方净收益、买方交割所需现金和每月住房成本、出租房产回报或固定利率按揭付款。Sumline 运行与 Sumline 网页应用相同的确定性计算引擎，返回经核验的数字、假设、警告，以及在 Sumline 中继续该情景的链接。Sumline 不判定贷款资格或负担能力，也不提供法律、税务、贷款、估价或投资建议。

payload.name: Bound MCP
payload.description: 读取 Bound API 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bound MCP helps users inspect Bound account balances, payment recipients, payments, FX orders, indicative exchange rates, and upcoming settlements through read-only Public API tools.
payload.longDescription: Bound MCP 通过只读 Public API 工具，帮助用户查看 Bound 账户余额、付款收款人、付款、外汇订单、参考汇率和即将进行的结算。

payload.name: Parallel
payload.description: 访问 Parallel 财务数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Parallel financial plan to Claude, ChatGPT, and any other MCP-compatible assistant. Ask questions about your model in plain language and get grounded, real-time answers pulled straight from your live data, with no exporting, no copy-paste, and no stale spreadsheets.

The server exposes Parallel's core planning surface as a set of tools: query your P&L, revenue and expense forecasts, headcount and hiring plans, monthly reports, and the assumptions driving your model. Your assistant can pull the exact numbers it needs to answer a question, compare scenarios, or summarize where the business is headed.

Access is read-only and secured with OAuth. Your assistant can explore and report on your financials but never modify them. You connect once, scope what it can see, and revoke access any time.
payload.longDescription:
将你的 Parallel 财务计划连接到 Claude、ChatGPT 以及任何兼容 MCP 的助手。用日常语言询问模型，即可直接从实时数据获取有依据的即时答案，无需导出、复制粘贴或使用过时的电子表格。

服务器将 Parallel 的核心规划功能开放为一组工具：查询损益表（P&L）、收入与费用预测、人员编制和招聘计划、月度报告，以及驱动模型的假设。助手可以提取回答问题所需的准确数字、比较情景或概括企业的发展方向。

访问为只读，并通过 OAuth 保护。助手可以探索和报告你的财务数据，但绝不能修改。只需连接一次，即可限定可见范围，并随时撤销访问。

payload.name: AIR Credit Intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AIR Credit combines powerful machine learning credit intelligence with AI agents directly inside ChatGPT. Instantly assess companies, uncover emerging credit risks before they become obvious, understand the drivers behind every rating, and test future scenarios in seconds. Whether you're evaluating counterparties, investments, suppliers, or borrowers, AIR helps you make faster, more informed decisions without leaving the conversation.
payload.longDescription: AIR Credit 将强大的机器学习信用情报与 AI 智能体结合，直接带入 ChatGPT。即时评估公司，在新兴信用风险明显显现前发现它们，理解每个评级背后的驱动因素，并在几秒内测试未来情景。无论评估交易对手、投资、供应商还是借款人，AIR 都能帮助你在不离开对话的情况下更快作出更有依据的决策。

payload.name: Laabam.One
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read your invoices, cash position and P&L — and draft new customers, invoices and bulk price updates for you to approve inside Laabam.One.
payload.longDescription: 查看您的发票、现金状况和盈亏情况——并为您起草新客户、发票和批量价格更新，供您在Laabam.One内审批。

payload.name: LedgerLens
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LedgerLens turns your transactions and uploaded bank statements into a conversation. Ask about recent purchases,  category spending, or specific merchants and get instant answers grounded in your own data. 
Upload statements once, then explore your finances by simply asking — no dashboards to navigate, no filters to configure. Your data stays in LedgerLens; ChatGPT reads it only during active tool calls through a secure OAuth connection you control.

payload.name: Cryptoworth
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cryptoworth lets ChatGPT read authorized Cryptoworth crypto-accounting portfolio data through 20 read-only tools. Users can inspect authorized portfolios, ledger transactions, connections and wallets, balance snapshots, DeFi positions, NFT holdings and activity, transaction labels, invoices, bills, and supported asset reference data. The app is read-only: it does not create, edit, delete, sync, recalculate, trade, transfer funds, sign transactions, or initiate payments.
payload.longDescription: Cryptoworth 通过 20 个只读工具，让 ChatGPT 读取已获授权的 Cryptoworth 加密资产会计投资组合数据。用户可查看获授权的投资组合、总账交易、连接和钱包、余额快照、DeFi 持仓、NFT 持有资产及活动、交易标签、发票、账单，以及支持的资产参考数据。应用仅供只读：不创建、编辑、删除、同步、重新计算、交易、转移资金、签署交易或发起付款。

payload.name: Chargebee (AU Region)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT to your live Chargebee subscription, invoice, customer, and payment data. Ask billing questions in natural language and get answers immediately: renewal risk, payment failure patterns, credit note gaps, LTV by billing cadence, trial conversion.

These cross-references work because Chargebee holds the full commercial event chain in one linked data model - payment events, plan changes, invoice records, cancellation reasons - all connected, all timestamped.
payload.longDescription:
将 ChatGPT 连接到 Chargebee 中的实时订阅、发票、客户和付款数据。用自然语言提出账单问题，即可立即获取答案：续订风险、付款失败模式、贷项通知单缺漏、按计费周期划分的 LTV，以及试用转化情况。

这些交叉关联能够实现，是因为 Chargebee 在一个相互连接的数据模型中保存完整的商业事件链，包括付款事件、套餐变化、发票记录和取消原因，全部互相关联，并带有时间戳。

payload.name: Lexfi
payload.description: 面向 AI 的金融数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lexfi gives ChatGPT access to structured financial data for research and analysis. It covers equities, macroeconomics, fixed income, institutional holdings, market sentiment, alternative data, and global markets through a unified MCP connection. Users can retrieve market data, company information, economic indicators, ownership activity, and financial signals directly in conversation. Lexfi is a financial data provider and does not execute trades or provide investment advice.
payload.longDescription: Lexfi 为 ChatGPT 提供结构化金融数据，供研究和分析使用。通过统一的 MCP 连接，覆盖股票、宏观经济、固定收益、机构持仓、市场情绪、另类数据和全球市场。用户可直接在对话中获取市场数据、公司信息、经济指标、所有权变动和金融信号。Lexfi 是金融数据提供商，不执行交易，也不提供投资建议。

payload.name: IFG
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
IFG brings official tax sources into ChatGPT for tax advisers, tax lawyers, accountants and in-house tax teams.

Research legislation, administrative guidance, case law, tax treaties, EU law and OECD publications across the jurisdictions available in IFG. Find a source from a citation or topic, browse a code or treaty, and open the relevant provision with its official publisher link.

Check available text versions and applicability information for a specified date. Read treaty provisions and their tax-effect dates, locate passages in long documents, and retrieve published legal changes. Use the cited sources to support research notes, client work and internal tax analysis.

Coverage, historical depth and applicability evidence vary by source and jurisdiction. IFG identifies missing evidence and partial results so professionals can assess the limits of each source.
payload.longDescription:
IFG将官方税务资料引入ChatGPT，服务于税务顾问、税务律师、会计师及企业内部税务团队。

在IFG涵盖的司法管辖区范围内，研究立法、行政指导、判例法、税收条约、欧盟法律及经合组织出版物。
通过引用或主题查找资料，浏览法典或条约，并通过官方出版商链接打开相关条款。

查看指定日期的可用文本版本及适用性信息。
阅读条约条款及其税收效应日期，定位长文档中的段落，并获取已发布的法律变更内容。
使用引用资料支持研究笔记、客户工作及内部税务分析。

覆盖范围、历史深度及适用性证据因资料来源和司法管辖区而异。
IFG会标识缺失证据和部分结果，使专业人士能够评估各资料的局限性。

payload.name: airpay
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your airpay account to access payment data through conversation. Ask ChatGPT about transactions, settlements, refunds, etc. and get instant answers without logging into your dashboard.
What you can do:
1. Retrieve transaction and order details
2. Check settlement and refund status
3. View payment analytics by date, method, or geography
4. and more.
payload.longDescription:
连接 airpay 账户，通过对话访问支付数据。向 ChatGPT 询问交易、结算、退款等情况，无需登录面板即可立即获得答案。
你可以：
1. 获取交易和订单详情
2. 查看结算与退款状态
3. 按日期、方式或地区查看支付分析
4. 以及更多功能。

payload.name: Lassie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lassie helps pet owners explore insurance quotes for dogs and cats in supported countries, confirm collected pet details, compare factual plan information, adjust quote options, and answer questions about Lassie coverage and policy terms.
payload.longDescription: Lassie 帮助宠物主人在支持的国家了解狗和猫的保险报价、确认已收集的宠物信息、比较客观方案信息、调整报价选项，并解答有关 Lassie 保障和保单条款的问题。

payload.name: HourProof
payload.description: 记录出租业务参与工时
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HourProof helps short-term and long-term rental owners keep contemporaneous material-participation records for tax purposes. Through ChatGPT, users log property-management activities as they happen ("log 90 minutes of turnover cleaning at Beach House yesterday"), review their activity log with date, property, and category filters, check year-to-date hours against their material-participation goals (100 hours for STR, 750 for LTR) with on-pace status, and cross-reference synced guest reservations when reconstructing work performed. Activities logged through ChatGPT are labeled as agent-logged in the user's audit trail and sync to the HourProof mobile app.
payload.longDescription: HourProof 帮助短租和长租业主为税务用途及时保存实质参与记录。通过 ChatGPT，用户可以记录发生的物业管理活动（“记录昨天在 Beach House 进行的 90 分钟换客清洁”），按日期、房产和类别筛选查看活动日志，将年初至今的工时与实质参与目标（短租 STR 为 100 小时，长租 LTR 为 750 小时）比较并查看进度是否达标，以及在回溯已完成工作时交叉核对同步的客人预订。通过 ChatGPT 记录的活动会在用户审计记录中标记为智能体记录，并同步至 HourProof 移动应用。

payload.name: Secfi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan and understand your equity compensation with Secfi. Get answers on your portfolio valuations, exercise costs, AMT exposure and model exit scenarios - all calculated from your actual equity data. Weather you’re trying to decide when to exercise or stress-testing potential exit outcomes, the analysis comes to you from Secfi’s calculation APIs.
payload.longDescription:
通过Secfi规划并了解您的股权补偿。
获取关于您的投资组合估值、行权成本、AMT税暴露及模拟退出情景的答案——所有数据均基于您的实际股权数据计算。
无论您是在决定何时行权，还是在压力测试潜在的退出结果，分析结果都将通过Secfi的计算API提供给您。

payload.name: Vaatun
payload.description: 寻找最佳保险科技方案
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vaatun is your assistant for modern Insurtech: the AI-native platform helping insurance brokers, MGAs, and intermediaries run and grow their business. Ask about broker CRMs, policy and claims automation, employee-benefits portals, and embedded distribution, and get straight answers plus side-by-side comparisons of Vaatun against tools like Saiba, Zoho, Sibro and IMTCare. Explore Vaatun's products (Vantage, Advantage, and Quik), read the latest Insurtech insights from the Vaatun blog, meet the team, and book a demo or trial without leaving the chat. Built for anyone evaluating how to digitize and scale an insurance intermediary business.
payload.longDescription: Vaatun 是你的现代保险科技助手：这一 AI 原生平台帮助保险经纪人、MGA 和中介机构经营并发展业务。询问经纪人 CRM、保单和理赔自动化、员工福利门户及嵌入式分销，获取直接答案，以及 Vaatun 与 Saiba、Zoho、Sibro 和 IMTCare 等工具的并排比较。探索 Vaatun 的产品（Vantage、Advantage 和 Quik），阅读 Vaatun 博客上的最新保险科技洞察，了解团队，并在聊天中预约演示或试用。专为任何正在评估如何将保险中介业务数字化并扩大规模的人打造。

payload.name: FactIQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FactIQ is a research data layer for AI agents. It gives users access to source-linked economic, market and company intelligence—including official statistics, structured company financials, filings and earnings-call evidence—inside tools such as ChatGPT and Codex.
payload.longDescription: FactIQ是为AI代理提供研究数据层的工具。它为用户提供通过ChatGPT和Codex等工具访问来源关联的经济、市场和公司情报的权限，包括官方统计数据、结构化的公司财务数据、文件及财报电话会议证据。

payload.name: FX Hedge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
FX Hedge brings C8's quantitative currency-hedging models into ChatGPT. Ask for the current hedge ratio between your base currency and any exposure - for example "my base is EUR, what's my hedge against USD?" - and get the model's ratio, the four signal drivers behind it (macro, trend, carry, value), and a detailed month-by-month breakdown with live ECB reference rates.

FX Hedge is decision support for treasury and investment teams. It provides analytics only: it does not give investment advice, make recommendations, or execute transactions. A C8 FX Hedge subscription is required; you sign in with your subscription email and a one-time code - no API keys.
payload.longDescription:
FX Hedge 将 C8 的量化货币对冲模型带入 ChatGPT。询问本位币与任意风险敞口之间的当前对冲比例，例如“我的本位币是 EUR，应如何对冲 USD？”即可获得模型给出的比例、背后的四类信号驱动因素（宏观、趋势、利差收益、价值），以及包含实时 ECB 参考汇率的逐月详细分解。

FX Hedge 为资金管理及投资团队提供决策支持。它仅提供分析，不提供投资意见、不作推荐，也不执行交易。需要订阅 C8 FX Hedge；使用订阅邮箱和一次性验证码登录，无需 API 密钥。

payload.name: wlthy
payload.summaryOriginal: Track net worth and cash flow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: wlthy is a net worth tracker for cross-border wealth. See your full portfolio, debts, and multi-currency cash flows across countries in one place, in any of 13 currencies. Import broker and bank statements, then break down allocation by asset class, loan-to-value, and FX exposure. Informational tracking only, not investment, tax or legal advice. wlthy never moves money or trades on your behalf.
payload.longDescription: wlthy 是一个面向跨境财富的净资产追踪工具。在一处查看跨多个国家的完整投资组合、债务和多币种现金流，可选择 13 种货币中的任一种。导入券商和银行对账单，然后按资产类别、贷款价值比和外汇风险敞口分析配置。仅用于信息追踪，不提供投资、税务或法律建议。wlthy 绝不会代表你转移资金或进行交易。

payload.name: Yoshi
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中了解你的财务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Yoshi brings your personal financial context into ChatGPT. Connect your accounts to get detailed visibility across balances, transactions, holdings, liabilities, and account activity in one place.

Ask questions about any account, transaction, or investment, and get detailed answers grounded in your own financial data. You can also set up agents to monitor changes, keep tabs on specific parts of your finances, and generate reports whenever you need them. Yoshi helps turn ChatGPT into a context-aware financial assistant built around your financial life.
payload.longDescription:
Yoshi 将个人财务上下文带入 ChatGPT。连接账户，即可在同一个地方详细查看余额、交易、持仓、负债和账户活动。

询问任何账户、交易或投资，获得以个人财务数据为依据的详细回答。你还可以设置智能体监控变化、关注财务的特定部分，并在需要时生成报告。Yoshi 帮助 ChatGPT 成为了解上下文、围绕你的财务生活打造的财务助手。

payload.name: Lightsplit
payload.description: 在聊天中分摊团体费用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lightsplit is a shared group ledger designed for trips, households, and teams, managed entirely through conversation. Easily create groups and share access via Web, LINE, or Telegram. Track expenses, income, and settlements with equal, weighted, or custom splits across multiple currencies. Attach receipts, optimize debt settlements with minimal transfers, manage shared to-do lists, set budgets, and view category-by-category spending breakdowns effortlessly.
payload.longDescription: Lightsplit 是为旅行、家庭和团队设计的共享团体账本，完全通过对话管理。轻松创建群组，并通过 Web、LINE 或 Telegram 共享访问。支持多种货币，以均等、加权或自定义方式分摊，记录费用、收入和结算。附加收据，以最少转账次数优化债务结算，管理共享待办清单，设定预算，并轻松查看各类别的支出明细。

payload.name: Fitch Solutions
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access trusted Fitch Ratings credit research and data, CreditSights intelligence, and BMI country and sector risk analysis — all through a single, governed MCP connection. Query ratings, financials, key rating drivers, research, and deal insights directly inside your AI workflows. Built for regulated environments with enterprise-grade authentication and entitlement controls. Fitch intelligence, where you work.
payload.longDescription: 通过一个具有治理控制的 MCP 连接，获取可信赖的 Fitch Ratings 信用研究及数据、CreditSights 情报，以及 BMI 国家和行业风险分析。直接在 AI 工作流中查询评级、财务数据、关键评级驱动因素、研究和交易洞察。专为受监管环境构建，提供企业级身份验证和授权控制。在你的工作场景中使用 Fitch 情报。

payload.name: RoboSystems
payload.description: SEC 披露文件知识图谱
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RoboSystems turns public-company financial filings into a knowledge graph ChatGPT can query directly.

SEC EDGAR: every public company's XBRL filings as one queryable graph. Pull a company's financial statements by ticker or CIK, pivot reported facts across companies, periods and dimensions, resolve a concept like "revenue" to its XBRL element, and run full-text search across filing narratives, then read the exact section.

Read a filing the way it was filed: list the statements and notes in a 10-K or 10-Q, then open one section whole, with its rows, breakdowns and the calculations that tie it together.

The graph also exposes read-only Cypher, so a conversation can move from a question ("show me NVIDIA's latest income statement") to a raw traversal ("which 2025 10-Ks mention goodwill impairment?") without leaving ChatGPT.

Authorization is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. This plugin connects only to the SEC EDGAR repository, which is read-only, and you can revoke access at any time. Open source (Apache-2.0): github.com/RoboFinSystems/robosystems
payload.longDescription:
RoboSystems 将上市公司的财务披露文件转化为 ChatGPT 可以直接查询的知识图谱。

SEC EDGAR：将每家上市公司的 XBRL 披露文件整合成一个可查询图谱。按股票代码或 CIK 获取公司的财务报表，对不同公司、期间和维度的已报告数据进行透视分析，将“收入”等概念对应到其 XBRL 元素，并在披露文件的文字叙述中进行全文搜索，然后阅读准确的对应章节。

按文件原始披露形式阅读：列出 10-K 或 10-Q 中的报表和附注，然后打开完整章节，查看其各行数据、明细及相互勾稽的计算关系。

该图谱还提供只读 Cypher，使对话能够从一个问题（“给我看看 NVIDIA 最新的利润表”）转向原始图遍历查询（“哪些 2025 年的 10-K 提到了商誉减值？”），无需离开 ChatGPT。

授权采用带 PKCE 的 OAuth 2.1。此插件仅连接只读的 SEC EDGAR 资料库，你可以随时撤销访问权限。开源（Apache-2.0）：github.com/RoboFinSystems/robosystems

payload.name: Rootline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rootline is a European payment service provider for platforms and marketplaces. This Model Context Protocol server connects your Rootline account to ChatGPT, so you can ask about any payment, merchant account, or settlement across your network.
payload.longDescription: Rootline 是面向平台和市场的欧洲支付服务提供商。此模型上下文协议服务器将你的 Rootline 账户连接到 ChatGPT，让你查询整个网络中的任何支付、商户账户或结算。

payload.name: Rillet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rillet helps finance teams retrieve financial data and manage accounting records, including invoices, bills, customers, vendors, journal entries, bank activity, contracts, and financial reports.
payload.longDescription: Rillet 帮助财务团队获取财务数据并管理会计记录，包括销售发票、应付账单、客户、供应商、会计分录、银行活动、合同及财务报告。

payload.name: Embat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Query your cash, debt, treasury forecasts, accounting, PSP reconciliations, payments, and intercompany positions in plain language — answered with your real numbers from Embat. TellMe inherits your existing permissions, so every reply is scoped to what you can already see. Make your treasury management system a native part of your AI workflow, without leaving the conversation.
payload.longDescription: 用日常语言查询现金、债务、资金预测、会计、支付服务提供商（PSP）对账、支付及公司间头寸——答案使用您在 Embat 中的真实数字。TellMe 继承您现有的权限，因此每个回答都限于您本来就可查看的内容。让资金管理系统自然融入 AI 工作流程，无需离开对话。

payload.name: Theia Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Theia Insights brings professional thematic equity research into ChatGPT. Ask about a structural trend: artificial intelligence, robotics, clean energy, cybersecurity; and surface the public companies most exposed, ranked by research-driven exposure scores rather than keyword matching or self-reported tags.

The data is built on the Theia Insights Industry Classification (TIIC): a five-level, one-to-many taxonomy mapping companies to 3,000+ investable themes based on what they actually do. Performance is tracked through Theme Watch Indices (TWI), with 10+ years of daily history across global regions.

What you can do in ChatGPT:

* Profile any company by ticker, ISIN, FIGI, or ticker — see its full thematic exposure from sector down to micro-theme.
* Screen for thematic exposure across public markets — find the companies most exposed to a given theme, sub-industry, or industry.
* Benchmark theme performance over time and rank themes by recent returns to identify leaders, laggards, and rotation trends.

Built for portfolio managers, research analysts, index providers, and allocators who need defensible, data-driven answers to thematic questions.
payload.longDescription:
Theia Insights将专业的主题股票研究带入ChatGPT。询问人工智能、机器人、清洁能源、网络安全等结构性趋势，即可找出相关敞口最大的上市公司，并按研究驱动的敞口评分排序，而非关键词匹配或自行申报的标签。

数据基于Theia Insights Industry Classification（TIIC）：一种五级、一对多的分类体系，按企业实际业务将其映射到3,000+个可投资主题。表现通过Theme Watch Indices（TWI）追踪，拥有覆盖全球各地区的10+年每日历史数据。

你可以在ChatGPT中：

* 按股票代码、ISIN、FIGI或股票代码了解任何公司，查看从行业板块到微观主题的完整主题敞口。
* 在公开市场筛选主题敞口，找出对特定主题、子行业或行业敞口最大的公司。
* 对主题表现进行长期基准比较，并按近期回报为主题排名，识别领先者、落后者和轮动趋势。

专为需要对主题问题获得有据可查、由数据驱动的答案的投资组合经理、研究分析师、指数提供商和资产配置者打造。

payload.name: Alpaca Paper Trading
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Alpaca’s ChatGPT Plugin provides direct access to paper trading execution via Alpaca's Trading API and Market Data API. 

Connect ChatGPT to your Alpaca paper account to place simulated trades across stocks, ETFs, options, and crypto. Monitor your positions, analyze market trends, and manage your account through natural language.

Insights generated by Alpaca’s MCP server, ChatGPT plugin and connected AI agents are for educational and informational use only and not investment advice. Do your own due diligence before making decisions.

AlpacaDB, Inc.’s Paper Trading API uses simulated funds and does not enable transactions in real securities. Its availability and content do not constitute an offer, solicitation, investment advice, recommendation, or endorsement involving securities, derivatives, futures, or trading strategies. The API is not offered in jurisdictions where AlpacaDB, Inc. or its affiliates (collectively, “Alpaca”) are not authorized to conduct business.

Options trading is not suitable for all investors due to its inherent high risk, which can potentially result in significant losses. Please read Characteristics and Risks of Standardized Options (https://www.theocc.com/Company-Information/Documents-and-Archives/Options-Disclosure-Document) before investing in options.

Please see the Disclosure Library at https://alpaca.markets/disclosures for additional information and disclosures from Alpaca Clearing and Alpaca Crypto.
payload.longDescription:
Alpaca 的 ChatGPT 插件通过 Alpaca 的 Trading API 和 Market Data API，直接提供模拟交易执行功能。

将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 Alpaca 模拟账户，即可对股票、ETF、期权和加密资产下达模拟交易指令。通过自然语言监控持仓、分析市场趋势并管理账户。

Alpaca 的 MCP 服务器、ChatGPT 插件及连接的 AI 智能体生成的见解仅用于教育和信息参考，不构成投资建议。作出决定前，请自行进行尽职调查。

AlpacaDB, Inc. 的 Paper Trading API 使用模拟资金，不能进行真实证券交易。其可用性及内容不构成涉及证券、衍生品、期货或交易策略的要约、招揽、投资建议、推荐或背书。在 AlpacaDB, Inc. 或其关联公司（合称“Alpaca”）未获准开展业务的司法辖区，不提供该 API。

期权交易本身风险较高，可能造成重大损失，因此并不适合所有投资者。投资期权前，请阅读《标准化期权的特征与风险》（https://www.theocc.com/Company-Information/Documents-and-Archives/Options-Disclosure-Document）。

有关 Alpaca Clearing 和 Alpaca Crypto 的更多信息及披露，请参阅 https://alpaca.markets/disclosures 的披露资料库。

payload.name: Menz Finance
payload.description: 获授权的个人与企业财务管理
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Consulte relatórios, lançamentos, contas, vendas, estoque e precificação, e registre operações financeiras dentro do Menz Finance. O plugin não movimenta dinheiro nem executa pagamentos externos.
payload.longDescription: 在 Menz Finance 中查询报告、账目分录、账户、销售、库存和定价，并记录财务操作。插件不转移资金，也不执行外部付款。

payload.name: B2B.nu
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
B2B.nu connects ChatGPT to the user’s Swedish ERP company. The app provides financial reports, customer and supplier data, CRM and quote details, products, personal tasks, time and projects. Available tools are filtered by company rollout stage, current user permissions and explicitly granted OAuth scopes. Existing connections do not automatically receive new write permissions.

New workflows create an exact preview and require the user to click the embedded approval button before changing records, sending invoices or quotes, or posting uploaded receipts and supplier invoices. Approvals expire after ten minutes and are bound to user, company, connection and record version. Outbound messages use email or configured Peppol/Maventa without automatic email fallback. Uploaded PDFs and images are limited to 10 MB and use the company’s existing OCR settings; originals are retained and linked to the resulting records. Duplicate detection, period locks and cash/accrual accounting rules apply.

Invoice line editing is limited to ordinary SEK drafts; quote conversion requires an accepted SEK quote linked to a domestic invoicing customer. CRM creation does not run CRM automations. The app never transfers money or deletes business records. Legacy core write tools retain their existing client-confirmation flow. New tools are activated in five stages per company.
payload.longDescription:
B2B.nu将ChatGPT与用户的瑞典ERP公司连接。
该应用提供财务报表、客户和供应商数据、CRM及报价详情、产品信息、个人任务、时间与项目管理。
可用工具根据公司部署阶段、当前用户权限和明确授予的OAuth范围进行筛选。
已有连接不会自动获得新的写入权限。

新工作流会生成精确预览，用户需点击嵌入的审批按钮后才能修改记录、发送发票或报价、或上传凭证和供应商发票。
审批有效期为10分钟，且绑定用户、公司、连接及记录版本。
外发消息通过邮件或配置的Peppol/Maventa发送，不启用自动邮件回退。
上传的PDF和图片限制为10MB，并使用公司现有的OCR设置；原始文件将被保留并关联至生成的记录。
启用重复检测、期间锁定和现金/应计会计规则。

发票行编辑仅限普通瑞典克朗草稿；报价转换需关联已接受的瑞典克朗报价及国内开票客户。
CRM创建不会触发CRM自动化流程。
该应用从不转移资金或删除业务记录。
遗留核心写入工具保留原有客户端确认流程。
新工具按公司分五个阶段激活。
